{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Enoch-Ahsokacharacterposter.png]] |name=Enoch |homeworld= |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' establishes that Enoch was a [[stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], who were [[human]]s according to ''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''. |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Ahsoka|Part Six: Far, Far Away}} |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *[[Thrawn's forces]] **[[Thrawn's Night Trooper legion]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|This is Enoch, captain of my guard.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|}} '''Enoch''' was [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Captain of the Guard]] during his [[Thrawn's forces|forces']] [[Exile (punishment)|exile]] from [[the galaxy]] on the [[planet]] [[Peridea]] since [[1 BBY]]. When [[Morgan Elsbeth]] brought her [[Intergalactic travel|intergalactic]] [[Hyperspace transport ring|transport ring]], the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'', there around [[9 ABY]], the [[captain]] [[Stormtrooper Commander|led]] Thrawn's [[Thrawn's Night Trooper legion|legion]] of [[Night Trooper]]s aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]] ''[[Chimaera]]'' to greet Elsbeth. Although the Imperials and their [[Great Mothers|Dathomiri allies]] wished to return to the known [[galaxy]], they also wanted to [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|eliminate]] the threat of the [[Jedi]] [[Ezra Bridger]]; Enoch introduced Bridger's friend [[Sabine Wren]] to a [[Sabine Wren's howler|howler]] in Peridea's [[Great Mothers' Fortress|Dathomiri fortress]] before sending them off into Peridea's wilderness, intending to track and destroy the Jedi using the [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] [[Baylan Skoll]] and [[Shin Hati]]. Thrawn's plans were interrupted by the warrior [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[Mission on Peridea|arrival]] at Peridea. Aboard the ''Eye of Sion'', Captain Enoch deployed [[RP82 Fiend fighter]]s to stall [[T-6 1974|Tano's shuttle]], which nevertheless joined Bridger and Wren on the planet surface. Enoch also prepared [[Team One|two]] [[Team Two|squads]] of [[trooper]]s to reinforce Skoll and Hati against Thrawn's enemies, but they persisted and reached the [[Dathomirian|Dathomiri]] fortress. By that [[time]], Enoch's troopers had completed transferring cargo from the catacombs to the ''Chimaera'', which docked with the ''Eye of Sion''; while Night Troopers volunteers and Elsbeth herself [[Battle of Peridea|battled]] the incoming warriors on Peridea, Enoch accompanied Thrawn on the ''Eye of Sion'' as it departed to the known galaxy, reaching the world [[Dathomir]]. ==Biography== ===Far, far away.…=== {{Quote|Be warned. Nomads wander this wasteland and prey upon each other for survival.|Enoch, to Sabine Wren|}} [[File:Ahsoka6-virginvariant-Rosanas.jpg|thumb|left|280px|Captain Enoch led the soldiers of Grand Admiral Thrawn.]] During the [[Galactic Civil War]]'s [[Liberation of Lothal|Battle of Lothal]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebellion]] and the [[Galactic Empire]] in [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Imperial [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] personal [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Chimaera]]'', was captured by a pod of [[purrgil]] summoned by the [[Jedi]] [[Ezra Bridger]].{{Rebels|Family Reunion – and Farewell}} [[Thrawn's forces]] and Bridger himself were subsequently stranded outside [[the galaxy]] on the [[planet]] [[Peridea]], in [[Far galaxy|another galaxy]]. While the Empire lost the war and was replaced by the [[New Republic]] in [[5 ABY]], Enoch was among the former Imperials in Thrawn's exiled forces and served as the Grand Admiral's [[Captain of the Guard]], in which capacity he acted as the head of [[Thrawn's guard|Thrawn's personal guard]] and [[Stormtrooper Commander|commanded]] the macabre ranks{{Topps|set=2024 Topps Star Wars Chrome Black|subset=Depths of the Dark Side|cardname=Captain Enoch|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/365613315355}} of Thrawn's loyal [[Night Trooper]]s, those [[stormtrooper]]s who had managed to survive their stay in the far galaxy. Enoch and those other stormtroopers managed to survive the unimaginable hardships of exile on Peridea{{InsiderCite|233|Launchpad}} despite the low resources at their disposal. Despite the isolation, Enoch dutifully served Thrawn and came to focus his loyalties upon the Grand Admiral alone, instead of thinking in terms of the greater Empire.{{Topps|set=2024 Topps Star Wars Chrome Black|subset=Embrace the Dark Side|cardname=Captain Enoch|link=https://www.ebay.com/itm/177015131633}} Enoch provided Thrawn with his own personal brawn as well. Reduced to a [[Thrawn's Night Trooper legion|single legion]]{{ThisWeek|lxo8qzDZM4E|Dispatch: Far, Far Away|sw_url=video/far-far-away-this-week-in-star-wars-dispatch}} over the course of their exile, the Night Troopers remained loyal to Thrawn and were energized via the magicks of the [[Great Mothers]],{{Databank|night-troopers|Night Troopers}} a grouping of [[Dathomirian|Dathomiri]] [[Nightsisters]] with whom Thrawn allied in order to return to the galaxy proper{{Ahsoka|Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord}} and to strengthen his forces. In return for their aid—which entailed the Great Mothers calling out to Thrawn's former follower [[Morgan Elsbeth]], who would be able to bring about Thrawn and company's delivery from exile—Thrawn promised to deliver the Great Mothers and their cargo from Peridea to the Nightsister planet [[Dathomir]] after their escape. With the alliance sealed, Thrawn's forces began the process of rebuilding the ''Chimaera''. Like the rest of the Night Troopers, Enoch was well saturated in Nightsister magick, which left it unclear if he was "alive" in any standard sense of the word. At one point, Enoch stood guard with a large [[blaster]] outside the [[Great Mothers' Fortress]],{{SWU|set=Legends of the Force|cardname=Captain Enoch |subtitle= Captain of the Guard|link=9722568619|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/wVvG7}} where the Great Mothers remained based. ===Exile at an end=== Their isolation ended with the arrival of Thrawn's servant [[Morgan Elsbeth]] in [[9 ABY]],{{AhsokaSeriesDate}} when her [[Intergalactic travel|intergalactic]] [[Hyperspace transport ring|transport ring]], the ''[[Eye of Sion]]'' reached Peridea's [[orbit]]. Elsbeth and her [[Mercenary|mercenaries]], [[Baylan Skoll]] and [[Shin Hati]], descended in a smaller [[Scion shuttle|starship]] to meet the Great Mothers at the [[henge]] atop Peridea's [[Great Mothers' Fortress|Dathomiri fortress]] before the group was received by the ''Chimaera'', which perched with its [[hangar]] encasing the site. In the hanger, [[Captain]] Enoch led Thrawn's [[legion]] to greet those [[Force-sensitive|Force users]] with the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] Grand Admiral himself. After Thrawn introduced Enoch as his [[trooper]]s' [[Commanding officer|leader]], the [[admiral]] agreed to begin transferring the Dathomiri catacombs onto the [[Star Destroyer]], as per his agreement with the Great Mothers for facilitating a means of returning to the known [[galaxy]]. The captain ordered his troopers to enter the catacombs while he himself stayed with Thrawn and his guests. [[File:EnochandCoSeeSabineOff-Pt6FarAway.png|thumb|right|350px|Enoch and his men saw Wren off on her quest.]] The Night Troopers also retrieved the [[prisoner]] that the mercenaries had brought with them—the [[Lothal]] rebel veteran [[Sabine Wren]], who wished to [[Quest to find Ezra Bridger|find]] her missing friend, Bridger. Wanting to hunt down the Jedi himself, Thrawn ordered Enoch to remove Wren's [[stuncuffs]] and to provide her resources to traverse the perilous wastelands of Peridea. Captain Enoch and several troopers led Wren down to the fortress' ground entrance chamber, introducing her to a [[Sabine Wren's howler|howler]] that had been domesticated as a mount. After commanding the [[Howler|creature]] to lie down for Wren to mount it, Enoch cautioned Wren about the violent [[Bandits of Peridea|nomads]] who lived on Peridea, and he passed on her [[WESTAR-35 blaster pistol|blaster pistols]] and [[Sabine Wren's lightsaber|lightsaber]] before the fortress entrance opened. Wishing that Wren would "die well," the captain stood alongside his troopers to watch her ride out into the wastelands. Baylan Skoll and Shin Hati subsequently rode out on howler mounts as well in pursuit of Wren. Enoch informed Thrawn, who had been inspecting a [[star map]] of the galaxy with Elsbeth in the fortress, of their departure. The captain turned to leave the room after acknowledging Thrawn's order to prepare two attack [[squad]]s and await Skoll's signal, but he swiveled back to face Elsbeth when she asked whether more troops should be sent to aid the mercenaries; the Grand Admiral insisted that they could spare no more soldiers due to their dwindling numbers in their exile and sent Enoch away. ===The din of space=== {{Quote|Captain Enoch. You have the coordinates. Open fire.|Grand Admiral Thrawn, ordering Enoch and the ''Eye of Sion'' to fire upon Ahsoka Tano's position|{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}}} Soon afterward, Elsbeth's pursuer and Wren's master, [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Mission on Peridea|arrived]] over Peridea with the Jedi droid [[Huyang]] on her [[T-6 1974|T-6 shuttle]]—they rode with a pod of purrgil, as the Great Mothers had foretold Thrawn with short notice. Nevertheless, the Grand Admiral made preparations. The purrgil flew into an [[Imperial minefield]] and re-entered [[hyperspace]], which Enoch, from aboard the ''Eye of Sion'', reported via [[hologram]] transmission to the Grand Admiral, who himself stood before a holographic display of the scene in the Dathomiri fortress. Enoch also reported the [[T-6 shuttle|Jedi shuttle's]] presence, and that the ''Eye of Sion'' had deployed nine of its [[RP82 Fiend fighter]]s to redirect Tano into Peridea's debris field. [[File:ThrawnHologram-PartSeven.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Enoch, via hologram, took orders from Thrawn to interrupt the arrival of Ahsoka Tano.]] Thrawn was satisfied, given that he knew Tano would behave similar to her [[Jedi Master|master]]—the headstrong [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] with whom Thrawn had worked [[Mission to Mokivj|decades ago]]—and ordered Enoch to withdraw the [[starfighter]]s and have them stand by; the Great Mothers pinpointed Tano's coordinates with their [[magick]], allowing Thrawn to summon Enoch to attack. The ''Eye of Sion'' unleashed a barrage of [[Turbolaser|laserfire]] into the debris field, and the [[Starship|fighters]] resumed their engagement with the escaping [[shuttle]] in Peridea's [[atmosphere]]. Meanwhile, the mercenaries had joined forces with the nomadic bandits and tracked Wren to Bridger, with Hati relaying the Jedi's coordinates to Captain Enoch. Informing Thrawn of the discovery via hologram, Enoch received the Grand Admiral's order to send two [[LAAT/le patrol gunship]]s to reinforce the mercenaries. However, Baylan Skoll pursued a goal of his own, and left Hati, the bandits, and the [[gunship]]s' Night Troopers to ambush the Jedi themselves, who were then joined by Ahsoka Tano and her shuttle. Despite the loss of [[Team One|Teams One]] and [[Team Two|Two]], Thrawn was satisfied with distracting the Jedi long enough for the ''Chimaera'' to complete its cargo transfer and depart Peridea. ===Shadows of starlight=== {{Quote|Grand Admiral, the TIE fighters made contact with the enemy and engaged.''"
"''Results?''"
"''A successful strike on the Jedi shuttle was reported before we lost contact with the flight group.''"
"''An acceptable outcome. Consider all of the TIE fighters lost. Mark their captain for a citation.''"
"''As you wish, Grand Admiral.|Captain Enoch and Grand Admiral Thrawn, on the TIE attack on the Jedi|}} Enoch returned to the Dathomiri henge, where Elsbeth informed Thrawn that the cargo transfer was completed, and the Grand Admiral ordered the captain to bring the ''Eye of Sion'' down from high orbit so that it could interlock with the ''Chimaera''. Enoch then told him that [[Comm/scan processor|com-scan]] had located the Jedi's shuttle, and Thrawn tasked the captain with dispatching two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] to engage it. Enoch walked back to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} hangar as the [[battle of Peridea]] went underway. The [[TIE series|TIE fighter]] attack successfully hit the Jedi shuttle before Enoch's command lost contact with the [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|pilots]]. [[File:EnochAndFriends-Hasbro.png|thumb|right|350px|Captain Enoch served Thrawn alongside his Night Troopers.]] The captain returned to Thrawn inside the Dathomiri fortress with the update. He was instructed to have the [[Squad leader|captain]] of the TIE [[squadron]] commended despite their losses and to show the Jedi's location on the room's holographic display. Thrawn concluded that preparation for an immediate ground assault was necessary, and Enoch gave way and followed as the Grand Admiral walked out of the fortress and up to the Dathomiri henge. There, they found Morgan Elsbeth and the Great Mothers preparing dozens of Night Trooper volunteers for combat with magick; the troopers had been made aware that they would serve Thrawn—and the Empire—even in [[death]]. Back in the fortress, Enoch, Thrawn, and Elsbeth heard from a [[Star Navigator droid|Star Navigator Droid]] who had been serving on the ''Eye of Sion'' that com-scan detected the incoming Jedi on their howler mounts. The ''Chimaera'' attempted to annihilate the warriors, but they entered the fortress, where they battled the Night Troopers. Enoch then followed Thrawn out of the fortress, and, alone, the Grand Admiral asked the Great Mothers at the henge to begin resurrecting the fallen Night Troopers below as more powerful [[zombie]]s to delay the Jedi. Morgan Elsbeth oversaw the ''Eye of Sion'' interlocking with the ''Chimaera'', but just before she reported to Thrawn at the henge that the preparations were completed, Enoch spoke with him in hushed tones: the Grand Admiral asked if the captain's information was valid, to which he replied that preparations were under way. Thrawn then told Elsbeth that she must remain behind to prevent the advancing Jedi from boarding the Star Destroyer. The Grand Admiral, the captain, and the Great Mothers then walked back to the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} hangar and entered the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Eye of Sion''. [[File:ThrawnEnochSion-PartEight.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Enoch stood beside Thrawn as the Imperial leader returned to the known galaxy aboard the ''Eye of Sion''.]] Per Thrawn's command, it fired at the Dathomiri fortress while taking off; Tano, Wren, and Huyang pursued Thrawn in their repaired shuttle after killing Elsbeth, but they were stranded on Peridea as the ''Chimaera'' and its ring returned to the known galaxy. Unbeknownst to Thrawn's forces, Ezra Bridger had infiltrated the ''Chimaera'' and found his way to the New Republic. Captain Enoch joined Thrawn and the Great Mothers on the observation deck of the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} cargo hold to inform the Grand Admiral that they were approaching the world [[Dathomir]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Here are your weapons. Die well.|Enoch, to Sabine Wren|}} [[File:Unlimited-Enoch.png|thumb|right|350px|Captain Enoch's face remained hidden behind a gold facemask.]] An imposing figure{{GentleGiantCite|set=Premier Collection Statues|pack=Captain Enoch|link=star-wars-ahsoka-captain-enoch-premier-collection-statue}} and ominous sentinel,{{Databank|captain-enoch|Captain Enoch}} Enoch was a human whose face was kept hidden behind the golden faceplace of his modified stormtrooper helmet. Through that helmet, he spoke with a gruff and metallic voice. Furthermore, his unique helmet helped him to stand apart from the assembled ranks of Thrawn's Night trooper legion. Enoch was once a true believer in the Galactic Empire but, over the course of his service to Grand Admiral Thrawn, came to center his loyalties into Thrawn alone. As one of Thrawn's right hand followers and his dutiful servant, Enoch provided the Grand Admiral with every last detail he could about whatever situation they found themselves in in order to help the Chiss strategize. Enoch was clearly immersed in the magicks of the Great Mothers, whose magicks energized Thrawn's forces. In the case of Enoch, however, it was unclear if any true sense of life existed under the sentinel's armor. Upon being introduced by Thrawn to Elsbeth and her mercenaries, Enoch gave a slow nod of acknowledgment and then gave a brisk nod toward his troopers as an order to enter the catacombs. He also nodded as a way of acknowledging orders from Thrawn. Enoch wished Sabine Wren to "die well" when he sent her out into Peridea's wilderness. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Tota.|Enoch, commanding a howler|}} [[File:Enoch-AG.png|left|thumb|450x450px|Enoch in his full armor with his [[blaster]]]] Like many of the stormtroopers stranded aboard the ''Chimaera'', Enoch's [[Color|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]] was weathered, with cracks throughout the [[plastoid]] [[armor]] plates over his black [[body glove]]. However, Enoch's body glove was burgundy{{HotToysCite|set=Television Masterpiece Series|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=#120: Captain Enoch|link=collectibles/star-wars-captain-enoch-hot-toys-913002}} for his arms and torso, and he donned crimson [[glove]]s. The armor was also mended with metallic [[gold]] accents{{HomeVideoCite|set=Ahsoka: The Complete First Season|featurette=Darkness Rising}} while several parts of the armor pieces were replaced by gray fragments. Large parts of the armor were also replaced by metallic gold pieces, including the completely golden left shoulder plate, abdominal plate, the left hand guard, and the right knee component. Enoch's captivating helmet, once a standard-issue piece of gear that was modified to advertise his rank, displayed two red Imperial crests emblazoned at the top and a golden metallic [[humanoid]] face plate mounted and hammered into it. Golden and gray elements also jutted out at the bottom of the helmet's front in a manner resembling the bottom part of a [[Imperial combat assault tank pilot]]'s helmet. Instead of a standard [[utility belt]], the captain kept a black [[SE-14r light repeating blaster|SE-14r]] [[blaster rifle]] with golden accents in his [[holster]], which he wore as a dark [[belt]] around a burgundy [[kama]]. As a member of Thrawn's surviving legion, Enoch traveled aboard the Star Destroyer ''Chimaera'' and the ''Eye of Sion''. He also knew how to command a howler to obey him. As Thrawn's right-hand lieutenant and leader of the Night Trooper forces, he further exercised command over starfighter and gunship units, including Elsbeth's scout guard fighters and the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} surviving compliment of TIE fighters and LAAT/le patrol gunships. He was even granted command of the ''Eye of Sion'' itself during the transfer of cargo to the ''Chimaera'' and thus gave orders for how to use its firepower, as per Thrawn's orders. ==Behind the scenes== ===Design and debut=== {{Quote|One of the coolest things I got to see happen was one day when Marcus ''[Napuri]'' was sculpting the helmet for Enoch and Dave ''[Filoni]'' came in. Dave was trying to explain the adjustments that he wanted and Marcus just gave his tool to Dave and asked him to show him. That is the level of collaboration we had and the type of collaboration Shawna ''[Trpcic]'' encouraged. And even though something like sculpting from scratch is VERY time consuming, Shawna knew it was important to do it correctly by having that hand touched element vs a computer that just spits it out perfectly.|Elissa Alcala|{{Instagram|username=27crossroads|url=p/C_DvI3RvqPI|name=[[Elissa Alcala]]|date=2024-08-24|quote=Today you will be getting x2 videos from our Ahsoka crew! First up is @marcusplus1 . Marcus was our sculptor and a mold maker on Ahsoka. One of the reasons why I think our costumes for Star Wars stand out is because of Shawna’s want to honor the OG trilogy by using techniques that they would’ve had access to then for the most part. So when it came to needing to make new armor we started out with clay and sculpting. On Captain Enoch, Baylan, Shin, Sabine Ahsoka the White, all their armor was either sculpted from scratch or we used found pieces as bases to build on top of and then sculpted something new. There was no 3D printing or scanning. One of the coolest things I got to see happen was one day when Marcus was sculpting the helmet for Enoch and Dave came in. Dave was trying to explain the adjustments that he wanted and Marcus just gave his tool to Dave and asked him to show him. That is the level of collaboration we had and the type of collaboration Shawna encouraged. And even though something like sculpting from scratch is VERY time consuming, Shawna knew it was important to do it correctly by having that hand touched element vs a computer that just spits it out perfectly. Marcus thank you for your excellent work on Ahsoka, i gotta say I think your work was hit, and I think the fans agree too. 🫶🦩.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/G06AQ}}}} Enoch was created for the ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'' television series, portrayed by the actor [[Wes Chatham]], who considered the role to be a highlight of his career as a long-time ''[[Star Wars]]'' fan.{{Instagram|username=officialweschatham|url=p/C01j4Jdu1MC|name=[[Wes Chatham]]date=2023-12-14|quote=Now that the strike is over, I can talk about one of the biggest thrills of my career, Playing Captain Enoch. "Return Of The Jedi" was the first film I saw in the theaters. I was five years old, and from that point on my dreams have been dominated by that galaxy far far away. Being a part of "Ahsoka" and the Star Wars universe is a dream come true for me, and I'm looking forward to the future.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/1DYfZ}} Enoch debuted in the [[Ahsoka Season 1|season one]] episode "[[Part Six: Far, Far Away]]," which premiered on [[September 19]], [[2023]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=.Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}} [[Brian Matyas]] served as the character concept designer for Enoch in [[Doug Chiang]]'s production design department.{{Instagram|username=brianmatyas|url=p/C8nnFgMPpPh|name=[[Brian Matyas]]|date=2024-06-25|quote=FYC: Ahsoka for Outstanding Production Design AND Outstanding Fantasy/Sci-Fi Costumes

I had the pleasure of character concept designing so so many looks for this wonderful show in pre-production under the brilliant direction of production designer @doug_chiang. It has been an honor to contribute to this amazing show and see these characters beautifully realized by the late, AMAZING costume designer Shawna Trpcic and her wonderful team of costumers, armorers, painters and illustrators. Everyone worked so incredibly hard to bring Dave Filoni's vision to life.

@dave.filoni @lucasfilm @trpcic @rosariodawson @natashaliubordizzo @emanesfandi @ivannasakhno @therealdianaleeinosanto @ahsokaofficial @televisionacad @mangtasticpaintnprops @marcusplus1 @imarioart @27crossroads la_norato @erikvontroy|archiveurl=https://archive.is/G8IRP}} Costume designer [[Shawna Trpcic]] then assigned specialty constume manufacturer [[Marcus Napuri]] to make Enoch's helmet based on Matyas' art. Napuri recalled that showrunner [[Dave Filoni]] mentioned that he had Enoch's character in mind "for quite some time" and was excited to sculpt the helmet. Initially modifying a resin cast of a standard stormtrooper helmet to the proportions set by Trpcic, Napuri then [[Wikipedia:Scratch building|scratch-built]] the cheeks and laid the helmet in clay for sculpting. Having been given [[Wikipedia:Ancient Greek sculpture|Greek sculpture]] references, Napuri further incorporated the stylings of Japanese [[Wikipedia:Kabuki|kabuki]] theater masks to perfect Enoch's aesthetic.{{Instagram|username=marcusplus1|url=p/Cxhfht_uav_|name=[[Marcus Napuri]]|date=2023-09-23|quote=Enoch! What can I say I'm so proud of the love this character is getting! What did I do? I was the lucky SCM that got the task of creating his helmet. When Shawna @trpcic gave me the concept art drawn by the amazing @brianmatyas my mind was racing with excitement. I had the honor of working under Dave Faloni's direction and truely it was an honor! I knew from the moment I saw the concept he was going to be a fan favorite. I took the task with the utmost responsibility... Dave had mentioned that he had this character in his mind for quite some time, so I knew he was special. Firstly I started with a resin cast TK helmet and I began to modify... the size and shape of the helmet I modified to fit the proportions Shawna wanted then I scratch built the side cheeks to match the concept art. Once I had the helmet I layed in clay to start sculpting the face. I was given references of Greek sculpture but it wasn't till I incorporated stylings of Japanese kabuki masks that I found the perfect aesthetic. Throughout the process Dave would vist and give notes till I finally had his approval, and Enoch was born. He was everything I hoped for! I went on to mold and cast him then it went on to the legend that is Tony @robotcclouds to begin a series of paint tests... and the end product is the perfection you see on screen. The armor was masterfully created by @erikvontroy all the soft parts were created by my talented husband @la_norato many people worked on this costume of which I wish I new everybody so I could give credit.... but above all is Dave of who it was an honor to work under!|archiveurl=https://archive.is/0Y3x6}} [[File:Enoch-PartSix.jpg|thumb|left|350px|Enoch's introduction in ''Ahsoka''.]] Filoni visited Napuri throughout the process and gave notes on Enoch's design, and Napuri asked the showrunner to sculpt lines directly on the helmet to indicate his desired adjustements. Assistant costume designer [[Elissa Alcala]] appreciated such close collaboration, which Trcpcic encouraged to make the most of each artist's input and also hand-crafted elements, intended to honor the making of the ''Star Wars'' [[original trilogy]] in the 1970s and 1980s with a lived-in aesthetic{{YouTube|video=QboTw1Ihvvg|text=Ahsoka Interview with Assistant Costume Designer, Elissa "E" Alcala | The Art of Costume Podcast|channel=@theartofcostume|name=The Art of Costume|date=2024-08-06}} as opposed to the exactness of 3D computer scanning or printing. After Filoni approved the design, Napuri molded and cast the helmet, with Trpcic assigning [[Tonymech Acosta Jr.]]{{Instagram|username=robotclouds|url=p/C_r8GRyxudG|name=[[Tonymech Acosta Jr.]]|date=2024-09-09|quote=Shawna,May the Force be with you. You assembled quite a team and one an Emmy. Special shout out to @27crossroads for continuing that vision. I will never forget the day Shawna came up to me and said”these are your characters “all the talent involved from sculpture @marcusplus1 tailors @la_napuri @sewgeeky535 @something.about.art @erikvontroy @meholgate Judah Mang and much much more. She always let her artist be an artist.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/GqyoA}} to conduct paint tests. [[Erik Troy]] then crafted Enoch's armor pieces, and [[Luis Napuri]] tailored the fabrics. Marcus Napuri downsized the helmet while Troy enlarged the chest armor to create a distinctive, "superhero" silhouette for the character. In [[September]], [[2024]], Shawna Trpcic was posthumously awarded an [[Wikipedia:Emmy Awards|Emmy]]—alongside assistant costume designer Elissa Alcala and costume supervisor [[Devon Patterson]]—at the [[Wikipedia:76th Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Awards|76th Primetime Creative Arts Emmy Winners]] in the Outstanding Fantasy/Sci-Fi Costumes category for ''Ahsoka''{{'s}} season finale "[[Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord]]." Alcala stated that production design was informed by Doug Chiang and Dave Filoni's sketches of the stormtroopers having different colors and wrappings, consequently using the Japanese [[Wikipedia:Kintsugi|kintsugi]] pottery-repairing technique to apply [[Wikipedia:Gold leaf|gold leaf]] into lines drilled into the armor. Alcala also said that production designers took the fabric that Trpcic picked for the Great Mothers for wrapping the stormtroopers after aging, kintsugi, and wrapping each strip with a red fabric, and Patterson added that Trpcic "put her spin on" Enoch to give fans a moment of awe even among the troops with individually unique costuming.{{WebCite|url=https://www.motionpictures.org/2024/09/ahsoka-emmy-winning-costume-designers-elissa-alcala-devon-patterson-on-carrying-on-a-cosmic-legacy|text="Ahsoka" Emmy-Winning Costume Designers Elissa Alcala & Devon Patterson on Carrying on a Cosmic Legacy|author=Bryan Abrams|date=2024-09-12|work=''The Credits'', [[Wikipedia:Motion Picture Association|Motion Picture Association]]|archivedate=20240912154940}} According to ''Ahsoka''{{'s}} artists, the work on Enoch and his Night Troopers strained [[Wikipedia:Los Angeles|Los Angeles']] supply of gold foil in mid-[[2022]].{{Instagram|username=theartofcostumepod|url=p/C-lN0zlSQF5|name=The Art of Costume Podcast|date=2024-08-12|quote=These are NOT the Stormtroopers are you looking for! 😂 Learn more about the costumes designed for Captain Enoch, Grand Admiral Thrawn, and the legion of sinister Stormtroopers guarding the Great Mothers’ Fortress in @ahsokaofficial on the most recent episode of @theartofcostumepod with @27crossroads The #Ahsoka episode of The Art of Costume Podcast is now available on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, YouTube, and wherever else you like to listen!|archiveurl=https://archive.is/9d9hU}} During the series' production, Wes Chatham spoke with Filoni about how Enoch's armor resembles{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/ahsoka-captain-enoch-wes-chatham-goes-behind-the-mask-8548945|text=Wes Chatham goes behind the (creepy) mask of ''Ahsoka'' villain Captain Enoch|author=Ross, Dalton|date=01-02-2024|work=[https://ew.com Entertainment Weekly]|archivedate=20240201195326}} the gold armor of [[Wikipedia:Mordred|Mordred]] in the [[1981]] film [[Wikipedia:Excalibur (film)|''Excalibur'']].{{WebCite|url=https://ukm.propstoreauction.com/lot-details/index/catalog/169/lot/46892|text=Lot #268 - EXCALIBUR (1981) - Mordred's (Robert Addie) Suit of "Golden" Armour|work=[https://ukm.propstoreauction.com Prop Store Auction]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/GrzI1}} Following ''Ahsoka''{{'s}} release, the actor hinted at the importance of Enoch, being the single stormtrooper introduced by Thrawn. ===Further appearances=== {{Quote|It was exciting and challenging alike. We had an idea for a sort of "death knight" approach to Enoch, someone who synergizes deeply with the majiks of the Nightsisters of Peridea though he lacks those sorts of powers himself, and gives his fellow Imperial Remnant allies added resilience while under his command.|''Galaxy of Heroes'' Designer "CG_Mouse," on working out Enoch for ''Galaxy of Heroes''|{{EA|url=games/starwars/galaxy-of-heroes/news/kit-reveal-captain-enoch|text=Kit Reveal: Captain Enoch}}}} [[File:PrimeCenturionArmor.png|thumb|right|180px|Enoch-inspired armor in ''The Old Republic'']] At the time of Part Six's release, [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] made an emoji of Enoch that was appended to the hashtag "#captainenoch." The hashtag "#enoch" briefly featured an emoji of another ''Ahsoka'' character—Ezra Bridger, whose emoji was also appended to the hashtags "#Ezra" and "#EzraBridger."{{Twitter|readingforknow1|status/1706729540226023740|Editor|date=26-09-2023|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/UnNZ9}} {{C|version archived on September 26, 2023 at 18:12:10 UTC; content now replaced}} Twitter subsequently corrected the error.{{Twitter|readingforknow1|status/1706729540226023740|Editor|date=26-09-2023|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/vUlaZ}} The [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} Update 7.4.1 added a "[[Prime Centurion armor]]" that was based on Enoch's character design. The armor was announced in the [[February 14]], 2024 update livestream and could be purchased and equipped by player characters via the game's [[Cartel Market]] feature.{{TORYouTube|vCBNVHEdvpo|Game Update 7.4.1 "Building a Foundation" VOD}} Enoch later appeared as a playable hero in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'', with the team behind the game revealing they planned for him to be an Imperial Remnant leader as soon as he made his first appearance in "Part Six: Far, Far Away." ''Galaxy of Heroes'' designer "CG_Mouse" designed the character as part of a team and reflected it was a challenging, yet exciting, process. The team approached Enoch as if he was a "death knight" who synergized with the Nightsister magicks, even if he himself did not have those powers, while also adding a degree of resilience to the Imperials he commanded. For his in-game "Last Command" ability, which found its name from author [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[1993]] Legends [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''The Thrawn Trilogy'']] novel ''[[The Last Command]]'',''[[The Last Command]]'' the developers originally planned for Enoch to hold up a hand-held hologram-projection of Thrawn, but the art department surprised the team with a life-size Thrawn hologram. His "Decay" effect was inspired by in part by how one must critically damage a zombie in [[Wikipedia:Dungeons and Dragons|''Dungeons and Dragons'']], but the team also knew to remain specific to Enoch's character and not be "too punishing." The character ability then had several other technical issues to work through before he was ready for release. Enoch then appeared on a card illustrated by artist [[Kyle Petchock]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Unlimited]]'' set ''[[Legends of the Force]]'' by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]. After being assigned the captain, Petchock worked on Enoch's art in late fall of [[2023]] via the Pro Create app on his iPad Pro.
